path.title: Database Engineering
path.description: Deep dive into database design, optimization, and administration. Master SQL, NoSQL, and data modeling.

nodes.title: SQL Fundamentals
nodes.description: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, JOINs, and basic query optimization.

nodes.title: Database Design
nodes.description: ER diagrams, normalization, relationships, and schema design principles.

nodes.title: Advanced SQL
nodes.description: Subqueries, CTEs, window functions, stored procedures, and triggers.

nodes.title: Indexing & Optimization
nodes.description: Query performance, indexing strategies, execution plans, and profiling.

nodes.title: NoSQL Systems
nodes.description: MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis: document, column, and key-value stores.

nodes.title: Transactions & ACID
nodes.description: Transaction management, isolation levels, and ensuring data consistency.
